# Design brief (per task)

Fill this in before writing UI. Keep it under one page. See
[`docs/UI-UX-POLICY.md`](../UI-UX-POLICY.md) for the authority order.

- Task / ticket: [id and title]
- Surface and platform: [web, iOS, Android]
- Users and their job: [who, what they are trying to do]
- Requirements that decide the design: [acceptance criteria, constraints]
- Design System inspected: [paths read; tokens and components to reuse]
- Primary art-direction skill (exactly one, or none): [name and why]
- Anti-generic items deliberately used, with reason: [or "none"]
- Sizes to check: [default 375, 768, 1280 px]
- Interaction and accessibility risks: [forms, focus traps, motion, contrast]
- Out of scope: [what this task will not change]
